Definition: from G5449; "physical", i.e. (by implication) instinctive:--natural. Compare G5591.
BiblicalUsage: Physikos means natural, what belongs to nature itself. Paul says in Romans 1:26 that men and women changed the natural use into what is against nature, and Peter calls false teachers natural brute beasts in 2 Peter 2:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe nature itself testifies to God's order, and twisting it is not freedom but ruin.
